name: TextField
summary: A labeled text-like input with associated help and validation messages.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Visible accessible name, associated with the native input.

props.name: hint / error
props.meaning: Described-by text; error also marks the input invalid. The owning form controls error announcements.

props.name: native input props
props.meaning: Includes type, value/defaultValue, autocomplete, required, id, handlers, ref and ARIA attributes. An omitted id is generated uniquely.

accessibility: Label and help/error IDs remain associated across renders. Caller-supplied aria-describedby is retained. Uses native input and validation semantics.
usage: Use for text-like inputs, including password and one-time codes. Supply appropriate autocomplete and validation attributes. Keep credentials in temporary form state only.

examples.label: Labels, help and errors
examples.description: Synthetic profile fields with no persistence or network request.
examples.code: <TextField label="Nome" hint="Como você aparece no IA-MNS." required />
